metrics.label: Task body wall time
metrics.definition: Opt-in trusted task-callable wall interval. Not independent instrumentation of arbitrary code.

metrics.label: Task thread CPU
metrics.definition: Current-thread CPU time in the instrumented task; excludes child processes and background threads.

metrics.label: Execution block wall time
metrics.definition: Elapsed monotonic time across the bounded execution block.

metrics.label: Execution process CPU
metrics.definition: Runner process CPU time, excluding descendant process CPU.

metrics.label: Output verification wall time
metrics.definition: Elapsed time for output verification, not pipeline-only runtime.

metrics.label: Worker wall time
metrics.definition: Elapsed monotonic time across the container worker window.

metrics.label: Worker cgroup CPU
metrics.definition: Accumulated CPU time, not elapsed time or electricity.

metrics.label: Peak memory
metrics.definition: Container lifetime high-water mark, not additive memory consumption.
